decision.breadth_rule: Choose breadth from non-economic heterogeneity, independent event coverage, data availability, and expected information gain after excluding every consumed identity and historical-only symbol binding; do not use a fixed panel size.

implementation_semantics.required_work: Deterministically materialize a frontier-relative structural candidate set, verify broker-native feasibility, score independent regime-conditioned information coverage, and emit a prospective scope artifact without opening an economic attempt.

selection_constraints: Use only prospectively reusable authority and fresh structural selection logic.
Require authenticated Pepperstone/cTrader symbol identity, historical coverage, transaction-cost fields, margin feasibility, and execution availability before any economic freeze.
Do not rerun C032 or reuse any outcome-exposed C032 evidence.
Do not authorize an economic outcome from this proposal.
Preserve one continuous EUR200 account, free-margin survival, recovery capacity, and anti-ruin constraints.
Treat V2-C006, V2-C012, and V2-C031 only as historical survivors, not as default prospective bindings.
Keep unresolved C006, C029, and C030 prerequisites as explicit gates for any later economic experiment.

next_research_state.selection_basis: Epoch23 regime-scope resolution and exploratory structural evidence provide the strongest distinct prospective information opportunity, subject to comparison against every open family.

objective.goal: Select the highest-information distinct prospective research wave from the complete eligible broker-native frontier while preserving EUR200 margin survivability and recovery capacity.
objective.information_gain_rationale: The complete 1576-symbol frontier and all ten open mechanism families remain eligible, while Epoch23 introduced regime-scope resolution, refreshed frontier features, opportunity mapping, and exploratory regime-conditioned structural evidence. A frontier-relative, regime-context-conditioned wave can test whether conditional state segmentation adds independent information beyond already consumed trend, reversion, breakout, cross-market, session-gap, ranking, and causal-model identities without reusing outcome-exposed candidates.
